stemMd: The median of seven distinct ordered values is 18. A new value larger than all seven is added. Which must be true of the new median?
explanationMd: For seven values the fourth is 18. For eight, the median averages the fourth and fifth, and the fifth is strictly larger because values are distinct.

distractorRationale.c: Keeps the odd-sample rule after the sample becomes even.
distractorRationale.d: Places the added high value below the middle.
